conditions.displayName: Current GCP backup failed, missing, corrupt or recovery evidence invalid

documentation.content: Current production: GCE hsr-worker-standby, us-central1-a. Daily encrypted backup at 03:00 Asia/Hong_Kong; deadline 05:00. Inspect hsr-gcp-state-backup.service and hsr-worker-production.service plus Cloud Run hsr-backup-monitor. Check GCS gcp-production/hsr-state/ and matching status event. Do not start a second publisher, replay jobs, delete recovery keys, or clear unknown Chrome locks. This metric aggregates the condition into one incident; no repeat-notification interval is configured. Existing independent watchdog-silence policy remains enabled.
